title: Coaching for Leaders (Dave Stachowiak) — 'If you build a great organization, the predators will come'
summary: Dave Stachowiak — host of one of the longest-running leadership podcasts on the network (1,000+ episodes, top of the leadership charts since 2011) — drops a 38-minute launch-eve episode with Eric, framed around a single instruction: protect what you've built before it gets taken.
blockquote: If you build a great organization, the predators will come. With the right principles in place, not only can you protect what you love, but help many people flourish because of it. In this conversation, Eric and I show you exactly where to start.
